name: nola_runtime.tsv
note: this list; release builds read the class c flag rows from the embedded copy

name: flags_s2core.tsv
note: flag defaults; without it every Lua-era flag reads its code default

name: flags_s2core_tail.tsv
note: flag defaults (tail of the old core)

name: flags_x0.tsv
note: C++ flag defaults; without it every new fix flag is off

name: weapons_main.tsv
note: weapon damage parity table; remote hits use the fallback damage

name: revive_items.tsv
note: items that revive a downed player

name: s2u_choice.tsv
note: dialog choice lock table; story choices are not host-locked

name: s2u_qitems.tsv
note: quest items given to both players

name: loot_sids.tsv
note: placed loot SIDs for the shared loot list

name: s2u_cont.tsv
note: container positions; without it the stash window auto-closes for the next player (ST3)

name: s2u_contk.tsv
note: container keys of the shared container list (ST3)

name: s2u_artspawn.tsv
note: artifact spawner positions; without it artifacts picked by one player stay in the other world (artsync)

name: s2u_equip.tsv
note: equipment kinds and ammo; without it the save mirror and loot share treat weapons and armor as plain items

name: s2u_basekit.txt
note: start gear kept out of the shared loot and save mirror (Skif gun, Jemmy armor)

name: s2u_kit.tsv
note: client post-tutorial start kit; without it the client gets nothing ("s2u_kit.tsv ausente; nada dado")

name: s2u_trade.tsv
note: trader places; without it the A-Life keep zones around traders are empty and traders can despawn

name: s2u_questitems.txt
note: quest item SIDs carried in the join snapshot; without it the join hands no quest items

name: nat_classes.tsv
note: natnpc class table; without it only the natcls class is synced

name: mc_tags.tsv
note: relay hub x1 tags for 3+ players

name: s2u_qobj.tsv
note: mission objective actors by quest guid (qhostonly, qobjsync)

name: s2u_dlg_header.tsv
note: embedded since D1, no DLL reader

name: flags.txt
note: written by the installer and by the player

name: farlook.txt
note: far body look captured from the live puppet

name: nola_lasthost.txt
note: last host for the join menu

name: role.txt
note: dev role override; release takes the role from the menu

name: s2x_data\*
note: loose dev override of the embedded tables

name: census.*
note: dev world census output (devcmd census); the release census check (build_release_cpp.py CENSUS_NEEDLES) is the marker

name: invariant*.tsv
note: dev invariant rules, loose override of the built-in s2m_census_inv.inc; the release census check is the marker

name: s2u_lockbehind.tsv
note: quest nodes that close a door behind the player, held until every connected player entered the trigger (lockbehind)
